hotelOpportunityThesis: Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown is a 157-room Harbourfront hotel at 249 Queens Quay West with about 11,000 sq ft across 20 meeting rooms (Admiral Ballroom 3,151 sq ft, roughly 240 theatre / 224 banquet), a walk from the Metro Toronto Convention Centre — a credible overflow, mid-size group and ancillary meeting option, not exclusive housing for 2,000+ attendee convention shows. Convention-scale event; realistic role for a 157-room Harbourfront hotel is delegate/speaker overflow, VIP lodging and side functions — not primary housing. Inference from supplied product: nearby Harbourfront city hotel suitable for a modest allocation, not exclusive 3,000+ delegate housing or main-congress sessions.
